title: ResourceReference
description: JSON Schema enforces intrinsic field shape and dependency-array uniqueness. Dependency ordering remains an intrinsic constructor/deserializer invariant. A resource_id may occur in dependency_ids so the self-edge is representable; ResourceManifestValidator reports it as PIH.RESOURCE.DEPENDENCY_CYCLE. Schema conformance alone does not establish a resolvable or accepted resource.

dependency_ids.description: Duplicate dependency IDs are rejected here. Strict identifier ordering is an intrinsic constructor/deserializer invariant; self-dependency is representable and belongs to ResourceManifestValidator.
